messages:
Tess: Tiny logistics question 

Friend dropping by at 2pm with a huge umbrella (foldable but dripping). Where's the best place to stash it without soaking the lobby? Also found an unclaimed padded envelope on Returns Shelf D4 labeled only 'UX Research' 

Cam: Umbrella 10pm tip 
We usually keep a metal bin by the east entrance for wet umbrellas. If it's massive, toss a towel under it and put it in Closet B2. I can grab one of the drying mats.
Diego (reception): I can pre-print a badge say "Tess guest"? I'll also leave a note to escort to West Lounge. For the envelope, I'll hold it at the desk and tag it "UX Research - unclaimed."
Owen (facilities): Closet B2 has a drying rack and a bin lined with absorbent pads. I'll put a spare towel there. If it's still dripping, we'll keep it isolated so it doesn't damage packages.
Rae: Seat poll 
West Lounge couch (cozy) or Library armchair (quieter)? I'm leaning Library for conversation.
MailBot: Delivery scanned: "ExpressMail" 
Location: Returns D4 
Item: 1x padded envelope "UX Research" 
Action: Hold for 72h then route to UX Ops if unclaimed. (automated)
Tess: Yes please pre-print "Tess - guest" Diego. Umbrella will be foldable but might drip. Appreciate the drying mat Owen. Rae 
I'll take Library armchair if it's free.
Diego (reception): Badge queued: "Tess - guest - 2pm" with note "escort to West Lounge/Library depending on preference." I'll keep the envelope at the desk and add a sticky saying "unclaimed - UX Research."
Cam: Quick FYI 
If the padded envelope is research consent forms, we should lock it in Secure Storage. I'll check in with Priya from UX.
Owen (facilities): Drying mat and towel placed in Closet B2 at 1:50pm. Label: "Umbrella drop - wet items." I also put a spare plastic bag for drips.
Liam: Library armchair 4 life 
I'll move a small side table over and make space for a stroller if needed. Also leaving a chair cushion for extra comfort.
Rae: Poll so far: Library 2, West Lounge 0. Library it is! I'll bring a mug warmer.
Diego (reception): Tess checked in at 2:02pm. Umbrella placed in Closet B2, towel under it. Envelope is at the desk tagged "UX Research - unclaimed". Escort sent to Library armchair.
Cam: Follow-up 
I messaged Priya in UX; she confirmed it's likely sample consent forms and asked MailOps to lock it in Secure Storage S2 if unclaimed by EOD.
MailBot: Action queued: move padded envelope from Returns D4 to Secure Storage S2 if not claimed by 23:59 today. (automated)
Tess: All good 
Thanks team, umbrella handled and comfy chair found. Big thanks to Diego & Owen for the fast help :thumbsup:
